title: The OlmoEarth Platform: Geospatial inference at planetary scale
summary: OlmoEarth is a geospatial inference platform by AI2 that enables planetary-scale analysis by combining satellite imagery, location data, and large language models. It provides tools for building and deploying geospatial AI models, with a focus on scalability, accessibility, and real-world applications.
highlights: OlmoEarth enables geospatial inference at planetary scale.
It integrates satellite imagery and location data with large language models.
The platform is designed for scalable and accessible geospatial AI applications.
